description: Source code for the SellingController class in ERPNext, handling sales transaction logic including validation, stock updates, and related operations.

classes.name: SellingController
classes.description: Controller class for handling sales transactions, inheriting from StockController, with methods for validation, stock updates, and related sales operations.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for the sales feed display.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes data when the sales document is loaded, including bin details for items.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the sales document.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets missing values for the sales document, including customer details and item info.

methods.name: set_missing_lead_customer_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates lead or customer details if missing.

methods.name: set_price_list_and_item_details
methods.description: Sets price list and item details for the sales document.

methods.name: remove_shipping_charge
methods.description: Removes existing shipping charges from taxes.

methods.name: set_total_in_words
methods.description: Converts total amounts into words for display.

methods.name: calculate_commission
methods.description: Calculates commission based on items and rates.

methods.name: calculate_contribution
methods.description: Calculates contribution of sales team members.

methods.name: validate_max_discount
methods.description: Ensures item discounts do not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: set_qty_as_per_stock_uom
methods.description: Sets item quantities based on stock UOM conversion factors.

methods.name: validate_selling_price
methods.description: Validates that selling prices are not below last purchase or valuation rates.

methods.name: get_item_list
methods.description: Returns a list of item dictionaries for stock ledger updates.

methods.name: has_product_bundle
methods.description: Checks if an item is part of a product bundle.

methods.name: get_already_delivered_qty
methods.description: Calculates total delivered quantity for a sales order detail.

methods.name: get_so_qty_and_warehouse
methods.description: Retrieves quantity and warehouse info for a sales order detail.

methods.name: check_sales_order_on_hold_or_close
methods.description: Checks if a sales order is on hold or closed.

methods.name: update_reserved_qty
methods.description: Updates reserved quantities for sales orders.

methods.name: set_incoming_rate
methods.description: Sets incoming rates for items based on valuation or return info.

methods.name: update_stock_ledger
methods.description: Creates stock ledger entries for stock movements.

methods.name: get_sle_for_source_warehouse
methods.description: Generates stock ledger entry for source warehouse.

methods.name: get_sle_for_target_warehouse
methods.description: Generates stock ledger entry for target warehouse.

methods.name: set_po_nos
methods.description: Sets purchase order numbers for the document.

methods.name: set_pos_for_sales_invoice
methods.description: Collects PO numbers for sales invoice.

methods.name: set_pos_for_delivery_note
methods.description: Collects PO numbers for delivery note.

methods.name: get_po_nos
methods.description: Retrieves PO numbers linked to related documents.

methods.name: set_gross_profit
methods.description: Calculates gross profit for items.

methods.name: set_customer_address
methods.description: Sets formatted customer address details.

methods.name: validate_for_duplicate_items
methods.description: Checks for duplicate items in the transaction.

methods.name: validate_target_warehouse
methods.description: Validates target warehouse settings for items.

methods.name: validate_items
methods.description: Validates item types for sales.
